/* p2m: background.js */
importScripts("db.js");

function pad(n) {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

function nowParts(d = new Date()) {
  return {
    date: `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`,
    time: `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`
  };
}

function stableUrl(platform, conversationId, href) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(href);
    u.hash = "";
    u.searchParams.delete("rid");
    u.searchParams.delete("ridx");
    return u.origin + u.pathname + (u.search ? u.search : "");
/* p2m: background.js */
  } catch {
    return `${platform}:${conversationId}`;
  }
}

async function getAllRecords() {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(STORE, "readonly").objectStore(STORE).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

async function getAllAsks() {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(ASK_STORE, "readonly").objectStore(ASK_STORE).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
/* p2m: background.js */
  });
}

  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(ANSWER_STORE, "readonly").objectStore(ANSWER_STORE).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);

async function findByConvKey(convKey) {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(STORE, "readonly").objectStore(STORE).index("byConv").get(convKey);
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || null);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}
/* p2m: background.js */

async function putRecord(record) {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
    if (record.id != null) tx.objectStore(STORE).put(record);
    else tx.objectStore(STORE).add(record);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

async function refreshCache() {
  const all = await getAllRecords();
  const asks = await getAllAsks();
  let answers = [];
  try { answers = await getAllAnswers(); } catch (_) {}
  await chrome.storage.local.set({ recordsCache: all, asksCache: asks, answersCache: answers });
}

async function addAskOnce(row) {
  const recordKey = row.onMsg ? onMsgRecordKey(row.platform, row.conversationId, row.nonce || row.ts) : ((row.source === "seen" || row.source === "seen-dummy") ? seenAskRecordKey(row.platform, row.conversationId, row.ts, row.text, row.responseId) : askRecordKey(row.platform, row.conversationId, row.ts, row.text, row.responseId));
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(ASK_STORE, "readwrite");
    const store = tx.objectStore(ASK_STORE);
    const getReq = store.get(recordKey);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const existing = getReq.result;
      if (existing) {
        const incoming = String(row.text || "");
        const dummy = existing.source === "seen-dummy" || existing.text === "(ask not logged)";
        if (dummy && incoming && incoming !== "(ask not logged)") {
          existing.text = incoming;
          existing.source = row.source || "seen";
          store.put(existing);
        }
        resolve({ added: false, recordKey, localIndex: existing.localIndex, filled: dummy && incoming !== "(ask not logged)" });
        return;
      }
/* p2m: background.js */
      const countReq = store.index("byConvKey").count(row.convKey);
      countReq.onsuccess = () => {
        const localIndex = row.localIndex || (countReq.result || 0) + 1;
        store.add({
          recordKey,
          convKey: row.convKey,
          platform: row.platform,
          conversationId: row.conversationId,
          text: row.text || "",
          ts: row.ts || Date.now(),
          responseId: row.responseId || "",
          localIndex,
          source: row.source || "live",
          createdAt: Date.now()
        });
        resolve({ added: true, recordKey, localIndex });
      };
    };
    tx.onerror = () => {
      if (tx.error && /constraint/i.test(String(tx.error))) resolve({ added: false, recordKey });
/* p2m: background.js */
      else reject(tx.error);
    };
  });
}

async function addAnswerOnce(row) {
  const recordKey = row.source === "seen" ? seenAnswerRecordKey(row.platform, row.conversationId, row.responseId, row.ts, row.text) : answerRecordKey(row.platform, row.conversationId, row.responseId, row.ts, row.text);
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(ANSWER_STORE, "readwrite");
    const store = tx.objectStore(ANSWER_STORE);
    const getReq = store.get(recordKey);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      if (getReq.result) {
        resolve({ added: false, recordKey, localIndex: getReq.result.localIndex });
        return;
      }
      const countReq = store.index("byConvKey").count(row.convKey);
      countReq.onsuccess = () => {
        const localIndex = row.localIndex || (countReq.result || 0) + 1;
/* p2m: background.js */
        store.add({
          recordKey,
          convKey: row.convKey,
          platform: row.platform,
          conversationId: row.conversationId,
          text: row.text || "",
          ts: row.ts || Date.now(),
          responseId: row.responseId || "",
          askKey: row.askKey || "",
          askLocalIndex: row.askLocalIndex || 0,
          localIndex,
          status: row.status || "finished",
          source: row.source || "import",
          createdAt: Date.now()
        });
        resolve({ added: true, recordKey, localIndex });
      };
    };
    tx.onerror = () => {
      if (tx.error && /constraint/i.test(String(tx.error))) resolve({ added: false, recordKey });
/* p2m: background.js */
      else reject(tx.error);
    };
  });
}


function stripAccountPrefix(title) {
  return String(title || "").replace(/^\[[^\]]+\]\s*/, "").trim();
}

function isGenericTitle(title) {
  const bare = stripAccountPrefix(title).toLowerCase();
  return !bare || /^(grok|chatgpt|gemini|google gemini|new chat|untitled|\(untitled\))$/.test(bare);
}

function shouldReplaceTitle(current, incoming, force) {
  if (!incoming) return false;
  if (!current) return true;
  if (incoming === current) return false;
  if (isGenericTitle(incoming) && !isGenericTitle(current)) return false;
/* p2m: background.js */
  if (force) return true;
  return stripAccountPrefix(incoming) !== stripAccountPrefix(current);
}

async function syncTitle(payload) {
  const platform = payload.platform;
  const conversationId = payload.conversationId;
  if (!platform || !conversationId || String(conversationId).startsWith("pending:")) return { ok: false, reason: "no-id" };
  return upsertConversation({ ...payload, text: "", titleSync: true, ts: payload.ts || Date.now() });
}

async function rebindPending(payload) {
  const platform = payload.platform;
  const conversationId = payload.conversationId;
  if (!platform || !conversationId || String(conversationId).startsWith("pending:")) return { ok: false, reason: "no-id" };
  const wanted = new Set((payload.texts || []).map((t) => String(t || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()).filter(Boolean));
  const asks = await getAllAsks();
  const pending = asks.filter((a) => {
    if (a.platform !== platform) return false;
    if (!String(a.conversationId || "").startsWith("pending:")) return false;
/* p2m: background.js */
    if (wanted.size && !wanted.has(String(a.text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())) return false;
    if (!wanted.size && payload.since && a.ts < payload.since) return false;
    return true;
  });
  let moved = 0;
  const touched = new Set();
  for (const ask of pending) {
    const next = {
      ...ask,
      conversationId,
      convKey: makeConvKey(platform, conversationId),
      recordKey: askRecordKey(platform, conversationId, ask.ts, ask.text, ask.responseId || "")
    };
    const db = await openDb();
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(ASK_STORE, "readwrite");
      tx.objectStore(ASK_STORE).delete(ask.recordKey);
      tx.objectStore(ASK_STORE).put(next);
      tx.oncomplete = resolve;
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
/* p2m: background.js */
    });
    touched.add(ask.convKey);
    moved += 1;
  }
  if (moved) {
    const convKey = makeConvKey(platform, conversationId);
    await upsertConversation({
      platform,
      conversationId,
      url: payload.url || "",
      title: payload.title || "",
      account: payload.account || "",
      text: "",
      ts: payload.ts || Date.now()
    });
    const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
    if (rec) {
      const all = await getAllAsks();
      rec.askCount = all.filter((a) => a.convKey === convKey).length;
      await putRecord(rec);
/* p2m: background.js */
    }
    const records = await getAllRecords();
    for (const key of touched) {
      const left = (await getAllAsks()).filter((a) => a.convKey === key);
      if (left.length) continue;
      const stale = records.find((r) => r.convKey === key);
      if (stale && stale.id != null) await deleteRecord(stale.id);
    }
   // await refreshCache();
  }
  return { ok: true, moved };
}

async function upsertConversation(payload) {
  const platform = payload.platform;
  const conversationId = payload.conversationId;
  if (!platform || !conversationId || conversationId === "pending") return { ok: false, reason: "no-id" };
  const convKey = makeConvKey(platform, conversationId);
  const href = stableUrl(platform, conversationId, payload.url || "");
  const account = String(payload.account || "").trim();
/* p2m: background.js */
  let title = String(payload.title || "").trim();
  const text = String(payload.text || "").trim();
  const ts = payload.ts || Date.now();
  const { date, time } = nowParts(new Date(ts));
  if (account) {
    const prefix = "[" + account + "] ";
    if (title && !title.startsWith(prefix) && !title.includes(account)) title = prefix + title;
    if (!title) title = prefix.trim();
  }

  let rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
  if (!rec) {
    rec = {
      convKey,
      platform,
      conversationId,
      url: href,
      title: title || text.slice(0, 80) || conversationId,
      titleLocked: false,
      account: account || "",
/* p2m: background.js */
      date,
      time,
      comments: "",
      askCount: 0,
      answerCount: 0,
      createdAt: ts,
      updatedAt: ts
    };
    await putRecord(rec);
    rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
  } else {
    rec.url = href || rec.url;
    if (account && !rec.account) rec.account = account;
    if (!rec.titleLocked) {
      if (account && rec.title && !String(rec.title).includes(account)) {
        rec.title = "[" + account + "] " + rec.title;
      }
      if (title && shouldReplaceTitle(rec.title, title, payload.titleSync)) rec.title = title;
      if (payload.titleSync && title) rec.titleUpdatedAt = ts;
    }
/* p2m: background.js */
    if (!(payload.titleSync && !text)) rec.updatedAt = ts;
    await putRecord(rec);
  }

  let savedAsk = false;
  let askMeta = null;
  if (text) {
    askMeta = await addAskOnce({
      platform,
      conversationId,
      convKey,
      text,
      ts,
      responseId: payload.responseId || "",
      source: "onMsg",
      onMsg: true,
      nonce: payload.nonce || ts
    });
    savedAsk = !!(askMeta && askMeta.added);
    if (savedAsk) {
/* p2m: background.js */
      rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
      rec.askCount = (rec.askCount || 0) + 1;
      rec.updatedAt = ts;
      await putRecord(rec);
    }
  }

 // await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, savedAsk, convKey, askKey: askMeta && askMeta.recordKey, askLocalIndex: askMeta && askMeta.localIndex };
}

async function importTurns(payload) {
  const platform = payload.platform;
  const conversationId = payload.conversationId;
  const wantAsk = payload.logAsk !== false;
  const wantAnswer = payload.logAnswer !== false;
  const turns = Array.isArray(payload.turns) ? payload.turns : [];
  if (!platform || !conversationId) return { ok: false, reason: "no-id" };

  await upsertConversation({
/* p2m: background.js */
    platform,
    conversationId,
    url: payload.url || "",
    title: payload.title || "",
    account: payload.account || "",
    text: "",
    ts: payload.ts || Date.now()
  });

  const convKey = makeConvKey(platform, conversationId);
  let asksAdded = 0;
  let answersAdded = 0;
  let lastAsk = null;

  for (const turn of turns) {
    const role = String(turn.role || "").toLowerCase();
    const text = String(turn.text || "").trim();
    const ts = turn.ts || Date.now();
    const responseId = String(turn.responseId || "").trim();
    if (role === "user" || role === "ask" || role === "human") {
/* p2m: background.js */
      if (!wantAsk || !text) {
        lastAsk = null;
        continue;
      }
      const meta = await addAskOnce({
        platform, conversationId, convKey, text, ts, responseId, localIndex: turn.localIndex, source: "import"
      });
      if (!meta.added && payload.overwriteText && responseId) {
        await updateNodeText({ recordKey: meta.recordKey, kind: "ask", text });
        asksAdded += 1;
      } else if (meta.added) asksAdded += 1;
      lastAsk = meta;
    } else if (role === "assistant" || role === "answer" || role === "grok" || role === "bot") {
      if (!wantAnswer || !text) continue;
      const meta = await addAnswerOnce({
        platform,
        conversationId,
        convKey,
        text,
        ts,
/* p2m: background.js */
        responseId,
        askKey: lastAsk && lastAsk.recordKey || "",
        askLocalIndex: lastAsk && lastAsk.localIndex || 0,
        status: turn.status || "finished",
        source: "import"
      });
      if (!meta.added && payload.overwriteText && responseId) {
        await updateNodeText({ recordKey: meta.recordKey, kind: "answer", text });
        answersAdded += 1;
      } else if (meta.added) answersAdded += 1;
    }
  }

  const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
  if (rec) {
    rec.askCount = (rec.askCount || 0);
    rec.answerCount = (rec.answerCount || 0);
    if (asksAdded) rec.askCount = (rec.askCount || 0); // recount below
    await putRecord(rec);
  }
/* p2m: background.js */
  const allAsks = (await getAllAsks()).filter((a) => a.convKey === convKey);
  const allAns = (await getAllAnswers()).filter((a) => a.convKey === convKey);
  if (rec) {
    rec.askCount = allAsks.length;
    rec.answerCount = allAns.length;
    rec.updatedAt = Date.now();
    await putRecord(rec);
  }
 // await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, asksAdded, answersAdded, askTotal: allAsks.length, answerTotal: allAns.length };
}

async function deleteRecord(id) {
  const recs = await getAllRecords();
  const rec = recs.find((r) => r.id === id);
  const db = await openDb();
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const stores = [STORE, ASK_STORE];
    if (db.objectStoreNames.contains(ANSWER_STORE)) stores.push(ANSWER_STORE);
    const tx = db.transaction(stores, "readwrite");
/* p2m: background.js */
    tx.objectStore(STORE).delete(id);
    if (rec) {
      const wipe = (name) => {
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(name)) return;
        const idx = tx.objectStore(name).index("byConvKey");
        const req = idx.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(rec.convKey));
        req.onsuccess = (e) => {
          const cursor = e.target.result;
          if (cursor) {
            cursor.delete();
            cursor.continue();
          }
        };
      };
      wipe(ASK_STORE);
      wipe(ANSWER_STORE);
    }
    tx.oncomplete = resolve;
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
/* p2m: background.js */
 // await refreshCache();
}


async function logSeen(payload) {
  const platform = payload.platform;
  const conversationId = payload.conversationId;
  const responseId = String(payload.responseId || "").trim();
  const role = String(payload.role || "").toLowerCase();
  const text = String(payload.text || "").trim();
  if (!platform || !conversationId || !responseId || !text) return { ok: false, reason: "no-id" };
  if (String(conversationId).startsWith("pending:")) return { ok: false, reason: "pending" };
  await upsertConversation({
    platform,
    conversationId,
    url: payload.url || "",
    title: payload.title || "",
    account: payload.account || "",
    text: "",
    ts: payload.ts || Date.now()
/* p2m: background.js */
  });
  const convKey = makeConvKey(platform, conversationId);
  if (role === "user" || role === "ask") {
    const meta = await addAskOnce({
      platform, conversationId, convKey, text, ts: payload.ts || Date.now(),
      responseId, source: "seen"
    });
    if (meta.added) {
      const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
      if (rec) { rec.askCount = (rec.askCount || 0) + 1; await putRecord(rec); }
    }
   // await refreshCache();
    return { ok: true, added: meta.added, recordKey: meta.recordKey };
  }
  let askKey = "";
  let askLocalIndex = 0;
  const parentId = payload.askResponseId || ("dummy-" + responseId);
  if (parentId) {
    const askMeta = await addAskOnce({
      platform, conversationId, convKey,
/* p2m: background.js */
      text: payload.askDummy || !payload.askResponseId ? "(ask not logged)" : (payload.askText || "(ask not logged)"),
      ts: payload.askTs || payload.ts || Date.now(),
      responseId: parentId,
      source: payload.askDummy || !payload.askResponseId ? "seen-dummy" : "seen"
    });
    askKey = askMeta.recordKey || "";
    askLocalIndex = askMeta.localIndex || 0;
    if (askMeta.added) {
      const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
      if (rec) { rec.askCount = (rec.askCount || 0) + 1; await putRecord(rec); }
    }
  }
  const meta = await addAnswerOnce({
    platform, conversationId, convKey, text, ts: payload.ts || Date.now(),
    responseId, askKey, askLocalIndex, status: "finished", source: "seen"
  });
  if (meta.added) {
    const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
    if (rec) { rec.answerCount = (rec.answerCount || 0) + 1; await putRecord(rec); }
  }
/* p2m: background.js */
 // await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, added: meta.added, recordKey: meta.recordKey };
}

async function updateNodeText(payload) {
  const recordKey = String(payload.recordKey || "");
  const kind = String(payload.kind || "");
  const text = String(payload.text || "");
  if (!recordKey || (kind !== "ask" && kind !== "answer" && kind !== "onMsg")) return { ok: false, reason: "no-key" };
  const db = await openDb();
  const storeName = kind === "answer" ? ANSWER_STORE : ASK_STORE;
  const savedKind = recordKey.includes("|onMsg|") ? "onMsg" : kind;
  const updated = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
    const store = tx.objectStore(storeName);
    const getReq = store.get(recordKey);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const row = getReq.result;
      if (!row) { resolve(false); return; }
      row.text = text;
/* p2m: background.js */
      store.put(row);
      resolve(true);
    };
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
  if (updated)// await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, updated };
}


async function recycleOne(recordKey, kind) {
  const savedKind = recordKey.includes("|onMsg|") ? "onMsg" : kind;
  const storeName = savedKind === "answer" ? ANSWER_STORE : ASK_STORE;
  const db = await openDb();
  const row = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
    const store = tx.objectStore(storeName);
    const getReq = store.get(recordKey);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const found = getReq.result;
/* p2m: background.js */
      if (!found) { resolve(null); return; }
      store.delete(recordKey);
      resolve(found);
    };
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
  if (!row) return null;
  const deletedAt = Date.now();
  const conv = await findByConvKey(row.convKey || makeConvKey(row.platform, row.conversationId));
  const copy = Object.assign({}, row, {
    deletedAt, kind: savedKind, originKey: recordKey,
    title: (conv && conv.title) || row.title || "",
    askLocalIndex: row.askLocalIndex || 0,
    localIndex: row.localIndex || 0
  });
  delete copy.recordKey;
  const id = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(RECYCLE_STORE, "readwrite");
    const req = tx.objectStore(RECYCLE_STORE).add(copy);
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
/* p2m: background.js */
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
  return { id, deletedAt };
}

async function recycleNode(payload) {
  const recordKey = String(payload.recordKey || "");
  const kind = String(payload.kind || "");
  if (!recordKey || (kind !== "ask" && kind !== "answer" && kind !== "onMsg")) return { ok: false, reason: "no-key" };
  const removed = [];
  if (kind !== "answer") {
    const db = await openDb();
    const kids = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const req = db.transaction(ANSWER_STORE, "readonly").objectStore(ANSWER_STORE).index("byAskKey").getAll(recordKey);
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
    for (const kid of kids) {
      const done = await recycleOne(kid.recordKey, "answer");
      if (done) removed.push(kid.recordKey);
/* p2m: background.js */
    }
  }
  const savedKind = recordKey.includes("|onMsg|") ? "onMsg" : kind;
  const one = await recycleOne(recordKey, savedKind);
  if (!one) return { ok: false, reason: "missing", removed };
 // await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, id: one.id, deletedAt: one.deletedAt, removed };
}

async function getRecycle() {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = db.transaction(RECYCLE_STORE, "readonly").objectStore(RECYCLE_STORE).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

async function updateRecycleText(payload) {
  const id = Number(payload.id);
/* p2m: background.js */
  const text = String(payload.text || "");
  if (!id) return { ok: false, reason: "no-id" };
  const db = await openDb();
  const updated = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(RECYCLE_STORE, "readwrite");
    const store = tx.objectStore(RECYCLE_STORE);
    const getReq = store.get(id);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const row = getReq.result;
      if (!row) { resolve(false); return; }
      row.text = text;
      store.put(row);
      resolve(true);
    };
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
  return { ok: true, updated };
}


/* p2m: background.js */
async function setLiked(payload) {
  const recordKey = String(payload.recordKey || "");
  const kind = String(payload.kind || "");
  const liked = !!payload.liked;
  if (!recordKey || (kind !== "ask" && kind !== "answer" && kind !== "onMsg")) return { ok: false, reason: "no-key" };
  const storeName = kind === "answer" ? ANSWER_STORE : ASK_STORE;
  const db = await openDb();
  const updated = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
    const store = tx.objectStore(storeName);
    const getReq = store.get(recordKey);
    let found = false;
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const row = getReq.result;
      if (!row) return;
      found = true;
      row.liked = liked;
      store.put(row);
    };
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(found);
/* p2m: background.js */
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
  return { ok: !!updated, updated, liked };
}

async function setConversationTitle(payload) {
  const convKey = String(payload.convKey || "");
  const title = String(payload.title || "").trim();
  if (!convKey || !title) return { ok: false, error: "missing conversation key or title" };
  const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
  if (!rec) return { ok: false, error: "conversation not found" };
  rec.title = title;
  rec.updatedAt = Date.now();
  await putRecord(rec);
  await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, convKey, title: rec.title, titleLocked: !!rec.titleLocked };
}

async function setConversationTitleLock(payload) {
  const convKey = String(payload.convKey || "");
/* p2m: background.js */
  if (!convKey) return { ok: false, error: "missing conversation key" };
  const rec = await findByConvKey(convKey);
  if (!rec) return { ok: false, error: "conversation not found" };
  rec.titleLocked = !!payload.locked;
  await putRecord(rec);
  await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, convKey, titleLocked: rec.titleLocked };
}

async function setAllConversationTitleLocks(payload) {
  const locked = !!payload.locked;
  const all = await getAllRecords();
  for (const rec of all) {
    rec.titleLocked = locked;
    await putRecord(rec);
  }
  await refreshCache();
  return { ok: true, locked, count: all.length };
}

// --------------------------------------------------
  // Manual sync: list / fetch sessions (restored from 0.3.7)
  // --------------------------------------------------
  function grokRoleOf(sender) {
    const s = String(sender || "").toLowerCase();
    if (s === "human" || s === "user") return "user";
/* p2m: content.js */
    if (s === "assistant" || s === "bot" || s === "grok") return "assistant";
    return s || "unknown";
  }

  async function listGrokSessions(limit) {
    const out = [];
    let pageToken;
    while (out.length < limit) {
      const url = new URL("https://grok.com/rest/app-chat/conversations");
      url.searchParams.set("pageSize", String(Math.min(30, limit - out.length)));
      if (pageToken) url.searchParams.set("pageToken", pageToken);
      const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", headers: { accept: "application/json" } });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("grok list " + res.status);
      const data = await res.json();
      for (const c of data.conversations || []) {
        if (!c.conversationId) continue;
        out.push({
          id: c.conversationId,
          title: c.title || "(untitled)",
          createdAt: c.createTime || "",
/* p2m: content.js */
          updatedAt: c.modifyTime || "",
          url: "https://grok.com/c/" + c.conversationId
        });
        if (out.length >= limit) break;
      }
      pageToken = data.nextPageToken || undefined;
      if (!pageToken) break;
    }
    return out;
  }

  async function fetchGrokTurns(id) {
    const enc = encodeURIComponent(id);
    const opt = { credentials: "include", headers: { accept: "application/json" } };
    const detailRes = await fetch("https://grok.com/rest/app-chat/conversations_v2/" + enc, opt);
    if (!detailRes.ok) throw new Error("conversations_v2 " + detailRes.status);
    const detail = await detailRes.json();
    const nodeRes = await fetch("https://grok.com/rest/app-chat/conversations/" + enc + "/response-node", opt);
    if (!nodeRes.ok) throw new Error("response-node " + nodeRes.status);
    const nodes = ((await nodeRes.json()).responseNodes || []);
/* p2m: content.js */
    const responseIds = [...new Set(nodes.map((n) => n.responseId).filter(Boolean))];
    const loadRes = await fetch("https://grok.com/rest/app-chat/conversations/" + enc + "/load-responses", {
      method: "POST",
      credentials: "include",
      headers: { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ responseIds })
    });
    if (!loadRes.ok) throw new Error("load-responses " + loadRes.status);
    const loaded = await loadRes.json();
    const byId = new Map((loaded.responses || []).map((r) => [r.responseId, r]));
    const turns = [];
    for (const rid of responseIds) {
      const r = byId.get(rid);
      if (!r) continue;
      const text = String(r.message || "").trim();
      if (!text) continue;
      const created = r.createTime ? Date.parse(r.createTime) : Date.now();
      turns.push({
        role: grokRoleOf(r.sender),
        text,
/* p2m: content.js */
        responseId: rid,
        ts: Number.isFinite(created) ? created : Date.now()
      });
    }
    const conv = detail.conversation || detail || {};
    return {
      title: conv.title || document.title,
      url: "https://grok.com/c/" + id,
      turns
    };
  }

  async function listChatGPTSessions(limit) {
    const sess = await fetch("https://chatgpt.com/api/auth/session", {
      credentials: "include",
      headers: { accept: "application/json" }
    }).then((r) => r.json());
    const token = sess && sess.accessToken;
    if (!token) throw new Error("chatgpt no session token");
    const out = [];
/* p2m: content.js */
    let offset = 0;
    while (out.length < limit) {
      const url = new URL("https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/conversations");
      url.searchParams.set("offset", String(offset));
      url.searchParams.set("limit", String(Math.min(28, limit - out.length)));
      url.searchParams.set("order", "updated");
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        credentials: "include",
        headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + token }
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("chatgpt list " + res.status);
      const data = await res.json();
      const items = data.items || [];
      for (const it of items) {
        if (!it.id) continue;
        out.push({
          id: it.id,
          title: it.title || "(untitled)",
          createdAt: it.create_time || "",
          updatedAt: it.update_time || "",
/* p2m: content.js */
          url: "https://chatgpt.com/c/" + it.id
        });
        if (out.length >= limit) break;
      }
      if (!items.length) break;
      offset += items.length;
    }
    return { token, out };
  }

  function chatgptMessageText(msg) {
    const content = msg && msg.content;
    if (!content) return "";
    if (typeof content === "string") return content;
    const parts = content.parts || [];
    return parts.map((p) => (typeof p === "string" ? p : (p && p.text) || "")).join("\n");
  }

  async function fetchChatGPTTurns(id, token) {
    const res = await fetch("https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/conversation/" + encodeURIComponent(id), {
/* p2m: content.js */
      credentials: "include",
      headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + token }
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("chatgpt conversation " + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    const mapping = data.mapping || {};
    const turns = [];
    const nodes = Object.values(mapping);
    nodes.sort((a, b) => {
      const ta = (a.message && a.message.create_time) || 0;
      const tb = (b.message && b.message.create_time) || 0;
      return ta - tb;
    });
    for (const node of nodes) {
      const msg = node && node.message;
      if (!msg) continue;
      const role = msg.author && msg.author.role;
      if (role !== "user" && role !== "assistant") continue;
      const text = chatgptMessageText(msg).trim();
      if (!text) continue;
/* p2m: content.js */
      turns.push({
        role,
        text,
        responseId: msg.id || node.id || "",
        ts: msg.create_time ? Math.round(msg.create_time * 1000) : Date.now()
      });
    }
    return { title: data.title || document.title, url: "https://chatgpt.com/c/" + id, turns };
  }

  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg, _s, sendResponse) => {
    if (!msg || !msg.type) return;
    if (msg.type === "list-sessions") {
      (async () => {
        const to = msg.to || 10;
        if (platform === "grok") {
          const rows = await listGrokSessions(to);
          sendResponse({ ok: true, platform, rows, account: detectAccount() });
          return;
        }
/* p2m: content.js */
        if (platform === "chatgpt") {
          const { token, out } = await listChatGPTSessions(to);
          sendResponse({ ok: true, platform, rows: out, token, account: detectAccount() });
          return;
        }
        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: "manual sync list not implemented for " + platform });
      })().catch((err) => sendResponse({ ok: false, error: String(err) }));
      return true;
    }
    if (msg.type === "fetch-session") {
      (async () => {
        if (platform === "grok") {
          const pack = await fetchGrokTurns(msg.id);
          sendResponse({ ok: true, platform, ...pack });
          return;
        }
        if (platform === "chatgpt") {
          let token = msg.token;
          if (!token) {
            const sess = await fetch("https://chatgpt.com/api/auth/session", { credentials: "include", headers: { accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json());
/* p2m: content.js */
            token = sess && sess.accessToken;
          }
          const pack = await fetchChatGPTTurns(msg.id, token);
          sendResponse({ ok: true, platform, ...pack });
          return;
        }
        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: "fetch-session not implemented for " + platform });
      })().catch((err) => sendResponse({ ok: false, error: String(err) }));
      return true;
    }
  });

  function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, "0"); }
  function formatStamp(d) {
    d = d instanceof Date ? d : new Date(d);

function getConversationId() {
  const href = location.href;
  const u = new URL(href);
  const hostname = (u.hostname || "").toLowerCase();

/* p2m: content.js */
  // User can add more
  const specialSites = ["chatgpt.com", "notebook.google.com", "gemini", "grok", "qwen", "claude"];
  const isSpecial = specialSites.some(tok => hostname.includes(tok));

  // Find the 3rd "/"
  let count = 0;
  let start = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < href.length; i++) {
    if (href[i] === "/") {
      count++;
      if (count === 3) {
        start = i + 1;   // start after the 3rd "/"
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (start === -1) {
    // fewer than 3 slashes
    return isSpecial ? "" : (u.host || "");
/* p2m: content.js */
  }

  // Cut at first "?" or end of string
  let end = href.indexOf("?", start);
  if (end === -1) end = href.length;

  const part = href.substring(start, end);

  if (isSpecial) {
    //return part || "";
            if (part.length <= 5) return "";
    return part;
  } else {
    // other sites: same extraction, fallback to host if empty
    return part || u.host || "";
  }
}



/* p2m: content.js */
function getConversationId_part() {
  const href = location.href;
  const u = new URL(href);
  const hostname = (u.hostname || "").toLowerCase();

  const specialSites = ["chatgpt.com", "notebook.google.com", "gemini", "grok", "qwen", "claude"];
  const isSpecial = specialSites.some(tok => hostname.includes(tok));

  // Match: after the 3rd "/" up to the first "?" or end of string
  // ^(?:[^/]*/){3}   → skip the first 3 slashes
  // ([^?]*)          → capture everything until ? or end
  const match = href.match(/^(?:[^/]*\/){3}([^?]*)/);
  const part = match ? match[1] : "";

  if (isSpecial) {
    //return part || "";
        if (part.length <= 5) return "";
    return part;
  } else {
    return part || u.host || "";
/* p2m: content.js */
  }
}

function getConversationId_lastpart() {
  const href = location.href;
  const u = new URL(href);
  const hostname = (u.hostname || "").toLowerCase();

  const specialSites = ["chatgpt.com", "notebook.google.com", "gemini", "grok", "qwen", "claude"];
  const isSpecial = specialSites.some(tok => hostname.includes(tok));

  const m = href.split(/[?#]/)[0].match(/\/([^\/]+)\/?$/);
  const part = m ? m[1] : "";

  if (isSpecial) {
    // special sites: ignore very short segments
    if (part.length <= 5) return "";
    return part;
  } else {
    // other sites: same extraction, fallback to host if empty
/* p2m: content.js */
    return part || u.host || "";
  }
}



  function getConversationId_original1() {
    const path = location.pathname || "";
    const u = new URL(location.href);
    const href = location.href;
    u.searchParams.delete("rid");
    u.searchParams.delete("ridx");
    let m;
    if (/chatgpt\.com|openai\.com/i.test(href)) {
      m = path.match(/^\/c\/([^/?#]+)/i) || path.match(/^\/g\/[^/]+\/c\/([^/?#]+)/i);
      if (m) return m[1];
    } else if (/gemini\.google\.com/i.test(href)) {
      m = path.match(/^\/app\/([^/?#]+)/i) || path.match(/^\/u\/\d+\/app\/([^/?#]+)/i);
      if (m) return m[1];
    } else if (/grok\.com|x\.com/i.test(href)) {
/* p2m: content.js */
      m = path.match(/^\/(?:chat|c|conversation)\/([^/?#]+)/i);
      if (m) return m[1];
      m = path.match(/^\/i\/grok\/([^/?#]+)/i);
      if (m) return m[1];
      m = path.match(/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})/i);
      if (m) return m[1];
    }
    //if (/google\.com/i.test(href)) return u.host
    
    
    for (const key of ["chat", "cid", "conversation", "conversationId", "c"]) {
      if (u.searchParams.get(key)) return u.searchParams.get(key);
    }
    //return "";
    return u.search? u.host+"search":u.host;
  }

  function looksLikeEmail(s) {
    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
  }
/* p2m: content.js */

  function detectAccount() {
    const candidates = [];
    const push = (s) => {
      s = String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (!s || s.length > 80) return;
      candidates.push(s);
    };

    if (platform === "chatgpt") {
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid='accounts-profile-button'], button[aria-label*='@'], img[alt*='@']").forEach((el) => {
        push(el.getAttribute("aria-label"));
        push(el.getAttribute("alt"));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("nav button, header button, [data-testid*='account'], [data-testid*='profile']").forEach((el) => {
        push(el.getAttribute("aria-label"));
        const t = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (looksLikeEmail(t) || /^@/.test(t)) push(t);
      });
    } else if (platform === "gemini") {
/* p2m: content.js */
      document.querySelectorAll("img[alt], a[aria-label], button[aria-label]").forEach((el) => {
        const a = el.getAttribute("aria-label") || el.getAttribute("alt") || "";
        if (/google account|@/i.test(a)) push(a);
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-email], [data-user-email]").forEach((el) => {
        push(el.getAttribute("data-email") || el.getAttribute("data-user-email"));
      });
    } else if (platform === "grok") {
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/"], [data-testid="SideNav_AccountSwitcher_Button"], [data-testid="DashButton_ProfileIcon_Link"]').forEach((el) => {
        push(el.getAttribute("aria-label"));
        const href = el.getAttribute("href") || "";
        const m = href.match(/^\/([A-Za-z0-9_]{1,30})$/);
        if (m && !/^(home|explore|search|i|notifications|messages|compose|settings|grok|chat)$/i.test(m[1])) {
          push("@" + m[1]);
        }
      });
    }

   // let email = "";

/* p2m: content.js */
    for (const c of candidates) {
      const em = c.match(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/i);
      if (em && !email) email = em[0];
      const cleaned = c.replace(/google account[:\s]*/i, "").replace(/\s*\(.*@.*\).*/, "").trim();
      if (!name && cleaned && !looksLikeEmail(cleaned) && cleaned.length >= 2 && cleaned.length < 48) {
        if (!/^(menu|settings|profile|account|open|close|send|new chat)$/i.test(cleaned)) name = cleaned;
      }
    }
    if (email && name) return `${name} / ${email}`;
    return email || name || "";
  }

  function titledWithAccount(title, account) {
    title = String(title || "").trim();
    account = String(account || "").trim();
    if (!account) return title;
    const prefix = `[${account}] `;
    if (title.startsWith(prefix)) return title;
    if (title.includes(account)) return title;
    return prefix + (title || "");
/* p2m: content.js */
  }

  function queryUserMessages() {
    const found = [];
    const add = (list) => { for (const el of list) found.push(el); };
    if (platform === "chatgpt") {
      add(document.querySelectorAll('[data-message-author-role="user"]'));
      add(document.querySelectorAll(".user-message-bubble-color"));
    } else if (platform === "gemini") {
      add(document.querySelectorAll("user-query, .query-text, .user-query"));
    } else {
      add(document.querySelectorAll('[data-message-author-role="user"]'));
      document.querySelectorAll("div.message-bubble, [class*='message-bubble']").forEach((b) => {
        const parent = b.parentElement;
        const cls = String((parent && parent.className) || "") + " " + String(b.className || "");
        if (/items-end|justify-end|self-end/.test(cls)) found.push(b);
      });
    }
    const seen = new Set();
    return found.filter((el) => { if (seen.has(el)) return false; seen.add(el); return true; });
/* p2m: content.js */
  }

  function messageText(el) {
    return normalizeAsk(el.innerText || el.textContent || "");
  }

  function pickHost(el) {
    const candidates = [];
    let n = el;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8 && n; i++) { candidates.push(n); n = n.parentElement; }
    let painted = null;
    let scoreBest = -1;
    for (const c of candidates) {
      if (!(c instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
      const r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.width < 40 || r.height < 12) continue;
      const cs = getComputedStyle(c);
      const bg = cs.backgroundColor || "";
      const opaque = /rgba?\(/.test(bg) && !/,\s*0(?:\.0+)?\s*\)$/.test(bg);
      const cls = String(c.className || "");
/* p2m: content.js */
      if (!(opaque || /bubble|query-text|user-message/i.test(cls))) continue;
      const score = (opaque ? 1000 : 0) + Math.max(0, 800 - r.width);
      if (score > scoreBest) { painted = c; scoreBest = score; }
    }
    return painted || el;
  }

  function getLayer() {
    let layer = document.getElementById("ai-ts-layer");
    if (!layer) {
      layer = document.createElement("div");
      layer.id = "ai-ts-layer";
      (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(layer);
    }
    return layer;
  }

  let nidSeq = 1;
  const stampBoxes = new Map();

/* p2m: content.js */
  function clearAllStamps() {
    stampBoxes.clear();
    const layer = document.getElementById("ai-ts-layer");
    if (layer) layer.replaceChildren();
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-ai-ts-nid]").forEach((el) => el.removeAttribute("data-ai-ts-nid"));
  }

  function ensureNid(el) {
    let id = el.getAttribute("data-ai-ts-nid");
    if (!id) {
      id = String(nidSeq++);
      el.setAttribute("data-ai-ts-nid", id);
    }
    return id;
  }

  function writeStampBox(box, when) {
    const { date, time } = formatStamp(when);
    box.innerHTML = `<span class="ai-ts-date">${date}</span><span class="ai-ts-time">${time}</span>`;
    box.dataset.ts = String(when);
/* p2m: content.js */
  }

  function placeBox(box, hostEl) {
    const r = hostEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width < 8 || r.height < 8) { box.style.display = "none"; return; }
    box.style.display = "block";
    const w = box.offsetWidth || 110;
    if (r.left - w - 8 < 8) {
      box.style.transform = "none";
      box.style.left = Math.round(r.left + 4) + "px";
      box.style.top = Math.round(r.top + 4) + "px";
    } else {
      box.style.transform = "translate(-100%, 0)";
      box.style.left = Math.round(r.left - 6) + "px";
      box.style.top = Math.round(r.top) + "px";
    }
  }

  function attachStamp(el, when) {
    const hostEl = pickHost(el);
/* p2m: content.js */
    const nid = ensureNid(el);
    let box = stampBoxes.get(nid);
    if (!box || !box.isConnected) {
      box = document.createElement("div");
      box.className = STAMP_CLASS;
      getLayer().appendChild(box);
      stampBoxes.set(nid, box);
    }
    writeStampBox(box, when);
    placeBox(box, hostEl);
  }


  function loadConvAsks(convId) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "get-asks", platform, conversationId: convId }, (res) => {
        if (chrome.runtime.lastError) { resolve([]); return; }
        const rows = (res && res.rows) || [];
        resolve(
          rows
/* p2m: content.js */
            .filter((r) => r.platform === platform && r.conversationId === convId)
            .sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts)
        );
      });
    });
  }

  function stampAll() {
    if (!settings.showStamps) {
      clearAllStamps();
      return;
    }
    const conv = getConversationId();
    if (conv !== loadedConv) {
      loadedConv = conv;
      convStampReady = false;
      convStampList = [];
      clearAllStamps();
      if (conv) {
        loadConvAsks(conv).then((rows) => {
/* p2m: content.js */
          if (loadedConv !== conv) return;
          convStampList = rows;
          convStampReady = true;
          stampAll();
        });
      } else {
        convStampReady = true;
      }
      if (conv) return;
    }
    const used = new Set();
    const liveNids = new Set();
    for (const el of queryUserMessages()) {
      const text = messageText(el);
      if (!text) continue;
      let when = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < convStampList.length; i++) {
        if (used.has(i)) continue;
        if (normalizeAsk(convStampList[i].text) === text) {
          when = convStampList[i].ts;
/* p2m: content.js */
          used.add(i);
          break;
        }
      }
      const nid = el.getAttribute("data-ai-ts-nid");
      const existing = nid ? stampBoxes.get(nid) : null;
      if (existing && existing.isConnected) {
        if (when) writeStampBox(existing, when);
        placeBox(existing, pickHost(el));
        liveNids.add(nid);
        continue;
      }
      if (!when) {
        if (!convStampReady && conv) continue;
        when = Date.now();
      }
      attachStamp(el, when);
      liveNids.add(el.getAttribute("data-ai-ts-nid"));
    }
    for (const [nid, box] of [...stampBoxes.entries()]) {
/* p2m: content.js */
      if (!liveNids.has(nid)) {
        box.remove();
        stampBoxes.delete(nid);
      }
    }
  }

  function isVisible(el) {
    if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const s = getComputedStyle(el);
    return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && s.display !== "none" && s.visibility !== "hidden";
  }

  function isEditable(el) {
    return el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || el instanceof HTMLInputElement || el.isContentEditable;
  }
/* p2m: content.js */

  function getSendButton() {
    const selectors = [
      'button[data-testid*="send"]',
      'button[aria-label*="Send" i]',
      'button[aria-label="Submit"]',
      'button[aria-label="Send"]',
            'button[aria-label="Search"]',
      'button[aria-label="search"]',
      'button[data-testid="chat-submit"]',
      'button[data-testid="grokSendButton"]',
      'button[data-testid*="submit"]',
      'button[type="submit"]'
    ];
    for (const sel of selectors) {
      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)];
      const found = candidates.find((el) => {
        const btn = el.closest("button") || el;
        return btn instanceof HTMLElement && isVisible(btn) && !btn.disabled;
      });
/* p2m: content.js */
      if (found) return found.closest("button") || found;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function findComposer() {
    if (lastActiveComposer && isVisible(lastActiveComposer) && isEditable(lastActiveComposer)) {
      return lastActiveComposer;
    }

    const sendButton = getSendButton();
    if (sendButton) {
      let node = sendButton.parentElement;
      while (node && node !== document.body && node !== document.documentElement) {
        const candidates = [
          ...node.querySelectorAll('[contenteditable="true"], textarea, input, .tiptap.ProseMirror')
        ].filter((el) => isEditable(el) && isVisible(el) && !el.closest("#peek-box"));

        if (candidates.length) {
          const b = sendButton.getBoundingClientRect();
/* p2m: content.js */
          const bx = b.left + b.width / 2;
          const by = b.top + b.height / 2;
          candidates.sort((a, b) => {
            const ra = a.getBoundingClientRect();
            const rb = b.getBoundingClientRect();
            const da = (bx - Math.max(ra.left, Math.min(bx, ra.right))) ** 2 +
                       (by - Math.max(ra.top, Math.min(by, ra.bottom))) ** 2;
            const db = (bx - Math.max(rb.left, Math.min(bx, rb.right))) ** 2 +
                       (by - Math.max(rb.top, Math.min(by, rb.bottom))) ** 2;
            return da - db;
          });
          return candidates[0];
        }
        node = node.parentElement;
      }
    }

    const selectors = {
      chatgpt: ["#prompt-textarea", '[data-testid="composer-text-input"]', 'textarea[placeholder*="Ask"]'],
      gemini: ["rich-textarea .ql-editor", '[aria-label="Enter a prompt here"]', '[contenteditable="true"]'],
/* p2m: content.js */
      grok: [
        '[data-testid="grokInput"]',
        'textarea[aria-label="Ask Grok anything"]',
        'textarea[placeholder="Ask anything"]',
        ".tiptap.ProseMirror[contenteditable='true']",
        '[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]'
      ]
    };
    for (const sel of selectors[platform] || []) {
      const el = document.querySelector(sel);
      if (el && isVisible(el)) return el;
    }
    const a = document.activeElement;
    if (a && isEditable(a) && isVisible(a)) return a;
    return null;
  }

  function getComposerText(el) {
    if (!el) return "";
    if (el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || el instanceof HTMLInputElement) return el.value || "";
/* p2m: content.js */
    return (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").replace(/\u00a0/g, " ");
  }

  function attachComposerListeners(el) {
    if (!el || el._dbgAttached) return;
    el._dbgAttached = true;

    el.addEventListener("focus", () => {
      lastActiveComposer = el;
    });

    el.addEventListener("input", () => {
      lastActiveComposer = el;
      lastComposerText = getComposerText(el);
    });

    // Re-read after paste
    el.addEventListener("paste", () => {
      lastActiveComposer = el;
      setTimeout(() => {
/* p2m: content.js */
        lastComposerText = getComposerText(el);
      }, 0);
    });
  }

  function ensureComposerAttached() {

  function getText(el) {

    return (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").replace(/\u00a0/g, " ");

  function settlePending(ask) {

    postLog("pending:" + ask.at, ask.text, ask.ts, ask.account, ask.source);

  function isGenericTitle(raw) {
    const bare = cleanTitle(raw).replace(/^\[[^\]]+\]\s*/, "").toLowerCase();
    return !bare || /^(grok|chatgpt|gemini|google gemini|new chat|untitled)$/.test(bare);
  }

  function postLog(conversationId, raw, ts, account, source) {
/* p2m: content.js */
    const title = titledWithAccount(cleanTitle(document.title), account);
    if (settings.logAsks && raw) convStampList.push({ text: raw, ts, conversationId });
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: "log-ask",
      platform,
      conversationId,
      url: sessionUrl(conversationId),
      title,
      account,
      text: settings.logAsks ? raw : "",
      source: source || "unknown",
      logAsks: settings.logAsks,
      ts,
      nonce: ts + "-" + (source || "x")
    }, () => void chrome.runtime.lastError);
  }

  function syncTitle(conversationId, rawTitle) {
    if (!conversationId || String(conversationId).startsWith("pending:")) return;
    const title = cleanTitle(rawTitle || document.title);
/* p2m: content.js */
    if (!title || isGenericTitle(title)) return;
    const key = conversationId + "\n" + title;
    if (key === lastSyncedTitle) return;
    lastSyncedTitle = key;
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: "sync-title",
      platform,
      conversationId,
      url: sessionUrl(conversationId),
      title: titledWithAccount(title, detectAccount()),
      account: detectAccount(),
      titleSync: true,
      ts: Date.now()
    }, () => void chrome.runtime.lastError);
  }

  function rebindPending(conversationId, texts) {
    const live = (texts || []).filter((t) => !settledPending.has(String(t || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()));
    if (!live.length) return;
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
/* p2m: content.js */
      type: "rebind-pending",
      platform,
      conversationId,
      url: sessionUrl(conversationId),
      title: titledWithAccount(cleanTitle(document.title), detectAccount()),
      account: detectAccount(),
      texts: live,
      ts: Date.now()
    }, () => void chrome.runtime.lastError);
  }

  function bindHeld(id, title) {
    if (!id || String(id).startsWith("pending:")) return;
    knownId = id;
    const batch = heldAsks.splice(0, heldAsks.length);
    for (const ask of batch) postLog(id, ask.text, ask.ts, ask.account, ask.source);
    rebindPending(id, batch.map((ask) => ask.text));
    syncTitle(id, title || document.title);
    console.log ("syncTitle(id, title || document.title) called from bindHeld (), id and title is : " , id , title);
    loadedConv = "";
/* p2m: content.js */
  }

  function schedule() {
    if (scheduled) return;

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      scheduled = false;

  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  function sessionUrl(id) {
    if (id && location.pathname.includes(id)) return location.href;
    if (platform === "grok") return location.origin + "/c/" + id;
    if (platform === "chatgpt") return location.origin + "/c/" + id;
    if (platform === "gemini") return location.origin + "/app/" + id;
    return location.href;
  }
/* p2m: content.js */

  function cleanTitle(raw) {
    return String(raw || "")
      .replace(/\s+[-|–—]\s+(Grok|ChatGPT|Gemini|Google Gemini)\s*$/i, "")
      .trim();
  }

  function bubbleBody(el, role) {
    if (role !== "user") {
      const md = el.querySelector(".response-content-markdown, .markdown");
      if (md) return messageText(md);
    }
    return messageText(el).replace(/^worked for \d+s\s*/i, "");
  }

  function geminiTurnId(el) {
/* p2m: content.js */
    const marked = el.querySelector("[id^='message-content-id-r_'], [id^='model-response-message-contentr_']");
    const markedId = marked && marked.id || "";
    const fromMark = markedId.match(/r_([0-9a-f]{8,})/i);
    if (fromMark) return "r_" + fromMark[1];
    let n = el;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12 && n; i++) {
      if (/^[0-9a-f]{8,}$/i.test(n.id || "") && n.id !== "chat-history") return "r_" + n.id;
      const inner = n.querySelector && n.querySelector("[id^='message-content-id-r_']");
      if (inner) {
        const m = inner.id.match(/r_([0-9a-f]{8,})/i);
        if (m) return "r_" + m[1];
      }
      n = n.parentElement;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function domTurnId(el) {
    const wrap = el.closest && el.closest("[id^='response-']");
    if (wrap && /^response-[0-9a-f-]{8,}$/i.test(wrap.id || "")) return wrap.id.slice("response-".length);
/* p2m: content.js */
    let n = el;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12 && n; i++) {
      const raw = n.id || "";
      if (/^response-[0-9a-f-]{8,}$/i.test(raw)) return raw.slice("response-".length);
      const mid = n.getAttribute && n.getAttribute("data-message-id") || "";
      if (mid.length > 4) return mid;
      n = n.parentElement;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function firstWalkBubbles() {
    const out = [];
    const href = location.href;
    const push = (el, role) => {
      const text = bubbleBody(el, role);
      if (!text) return;
      out.push({ role, uid: domTurnId(el), text });
    };
    const take = (userSel, ansSel) => {
/* p2m: content.js */
      document.querySelectorAll(userSel).forEach((el) => push(el, "user"));
      document.querySelectorAll(ansSel).forEach((el) => push(el, "assistant"));
    };
    
    
    
    
    if (/grok\.com|x\.com/i.test(href)) {
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid='chat-transcript-scroller'] div[id^='response-']").forEach((wrap) => {
        if (!/^response-[0-9a-f-]{8,}$/i.test(wrap.id || "")) return;
        const uid = wrap.id.slice("response-".length);
        const user = wrap.querySelector("[data-testid='user-message']");
        const ans = wrap.querySelector("[data-testid='assistant-message']");
        const el = user || ans;
        if (!el) return;
        const md = el.querySelector(".response-content-markdown, .markdown, p");
        const text = messageText(md || el).replace(/^worked for \d+s\s*/i, "");
        if (!text) return;
        out.push({ role: user ? "user" : "assistant", uid, text });
      });
/* p2m: content.js */
      // fallback if the scroller structure is missing
      if (!out.length) take('[data-message-author-role="user"]', '[data-message-author-role="assistant"]');
    } else if (/chatgpt\.com|openai\.com/i.test(href)) {
      take('[data-message-author-role="user"]', '[data-message-author-role="assistant"]');
    } else if (/gemini\.google\.com/i.test(href)) {
      document.querySelectorAll("user-query").forEach((el) => {
        const uid = geminiTurnId(el);
        const text = messageText(el);
        if (uid && text) out.push({ role: "user", uid, text });
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("model-response").forEach((el) => {
        const body = el.querySelector("message-content, model-response-content, .model-response-text") || el;
        const uid = geminiTurnId(el);
        const text = messageText(body);
        if (uid && text) out.push({ role: "assistant", uid, text });
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

/* p2m: content.js */
  function seenPrefix(ts) {
    const d = new Date(ts);
    const z = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
    if (!Number.isFinite(ts) || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "SEEN_ONLINE: ";
    return "SEEN_ONLINE: " + d.getFullYear() + "-" + z(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + z(d.getDate()) + " " + z(d.getHours()) + ":" + z(d.getMinutes()) + ":" + z(d.getSeconds()) + " ";
  }

  function seenDebug(line) {
    let box = document.getElementById("ai-seen-debug");
    if (!settings.showSeenDebug) {
      if (box) box.remove();
      return;
    }
    if (!box) {
      box = document.createElement("div");
      box.id = "ai-seen-debug";
      box.style.cssText = "position:fixed;top:72px;right:12px;z-index:2147483646;width:460px;max-height:46vh;overflow:auto;background:rgba(12,16,24,.62);color:#f2f2f2;font:12px/1.45 Consolas,monospace;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:8px;";
      const bar = document.createElement("div");
      bar.textContent = "seen debug (drag)";
      bar.style.cssText = "cursor:move;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;";
/* p2m: content.js */
      const pre = document.createElement("pre");
      pre.id = "ai-seen-debug-log";
      pre.style.cssText = "margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;";
      box.appendChild(bar);
      box.appendChild(pre);
      document.documentElement.appendChild(box);
      let drag = false, dx = 0, dy = 0;
      bar.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { drag = true; dx = e.clientX - box.offsetLeft; dy = e.clientY - box.offsetTop; });
      window.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
        if (!drag) return;
        box.style.left = (e.clientX - dx) + "px";
        box.style.top = (e.clientY - dy) + "px";
        box.style.right = "auto";
      });
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", () => { drag = false; });
    }
    const pre = document.getElementById("ai-seen-debug-log");
    if (pre) pre.textContent = (line + "\n" + pre.textContent).slice(0, 5000);
  }

/* p2m: content.js */
  function postSeen(convId, role, responseId, text, ts, ask) {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: "log-seen",
      platform,
      conversationId: convId,
      responseId,
      role,
      text,
      ts,
      url: sessionUrl(convId),
      title: titledWithAccount(cleanTitle(document.title), detectAccount()),
      account: detectAccount(),

const DB_NAME = "aiChatAskLog";

function migrateSeenCompositeKeys(tx) {

function buildGlobalChronologicalIndex() {

        if (showAskNode(c) && !seen.has(askNid)) {

          entries.push({ nid: askNid, ts: Number(c.ts) || 0, seq: seq++ });
        }
        (c.answers || []).forEach(function (a) {

  globalNidByIndex = new Map();
  entries.forEach(function (entry, i) {

    globalIndexByNid.set(entry.nid, index);
    globalNidByIndex.set(index, entry.nid);

function drawExistingTimeHitStrip(items) {

  // to the available width; item colors are assigned discretely, not blended.

  canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return;
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak1.js */
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  if (!total) return;

  for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {

      ? "#9aa0a6"                         // no active keyword search
      : searchHitNids.has(items[i].nid)
        ? "#269b68"                       // item has a keyword hit
        : "#d7a33d";                      // existing item, but no keyword hit
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(i, 0, 1, height);
  }

function collectItems(sessions, tokens) {

      const showAll = (chatUnfoldModes.get(String(r.convKey)) || "hit") === "all";
      if (tokens.length && !showAll && !askHit && !ansHit) return;
      items.push({
        ts: c.ts || 0,
        convKey: r.convKey,
        session: r,

function groupItems(items) {

    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (!last || last.convKey !== it.convKey) {

    } else {
      last.items.push(it);
    }
  });
  return groups;
}

async function loadRecycle() {
  recycleItems = [];
  recycleAsks.clear();
  recycleChats = [];

    const res = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "get-recycle" });
    recycleItems = (res && res.rows) || [];
  } catch (_) {}
  const chats = new Map();
  recycleItems.forEach(function (item) {
    const convKey = item.convKey || ("recycle|" + item.id);
    if (!chats.has(convKey)) {
      const d = new Date(item.deletedAt || item.ts || Date.now());
      chats.set(convKey, {
        id: item.id,
        convKey: convKey,
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak1.js */
        platform: item.platform || "",
        title: item.title || (rows.find(function (r) { return r.convKey === convKey; }) || {}).title || "(recycled)",
        conversationId: item.conversationId || "",
        url: item.url || "",
        date: fmtTs(d.getTime()).slice(0, 10),
        time: fmtTs(d.getTime()).slice(11),
        deletedAt: item.deletedAt || 0,
        askCount: 0
      });
    }
    const list = recycleAsks.get(convKey) || [];
    const kind = item.kind || (String(item.originKey || "").includes("|onMsg|") ? "onMsg" : "ask");
    if (kind === "answer") {
      const parentIndex = item.askLocalIndex || 0;
      let parent = list.find(function (a) { return a.localIndex === parentIndex && a.kind !== "answer"; });
      if (!parent) {
        parent = {
          recordKey: "recycle-dummy:" + item.id,
          text: "(ask not logged)",
          ts: item.ts || 0,
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak1.js */
          source: "seen-dummy",
          kind: "ask",
          localIndex: parentIndex || "?",
          answers: []
        };
        list.push(parent);
      }
      parent.answers.push({
        recordKey: "recycle:" + item.id,
        text: item.text || "",
        ts: item.ts || 0,
        localIndex: item.localIndex || item.id,
        source: "seen"
      });
    } else {
      list.push({
        recordKey: "recycle:" + item.id,
        text: item.text || "",
        ts: item.ts || 0,
        deletedAt: item.deletedAt || 0,
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak1.js */
        responseId: item.responseId || "",
        source: kind === "onMsg" ? "onMsg" : "seen",
        kind: kind,
        localIndex: item.localIndex || item.id,
        answers: []
      });
    }
    recycleAsks.set(convKey, list);
    chats.get(convKey).askCount = list.length;

const MAX_WINDOW = 300; // Can safely handle small or large windows now

function enforceSlidingWindow(direction) {
  if (isSliding) return;
  isSliding = true;

  try {
    if (middleMode !== "item" || !datetimeItems.length) return;

    const tb = $("dateTimeView");
    const wrap = document.querySelector(".listwrap");
    const tokens = parseSearch($("q").value).tokens;

    dtStart = 0;
    dtEnd = datetimeItems.length;
    // Fixed list: do not append, prepend, or trim a datetime window.
    return;

    if (direction === "down") {
      if (dtEnd < datetimeItems.length) {
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak1.js */
        dtEnd = Math.min(datetimeItems.length, dtEnd + DT_BATCH);

        // Enforce maximum window size by shifting dtStart forward if needed.
        if (dtEnd - dtStart > MAX_WINDOW) {
          dtStart = dtEnd - MAX_WINDOW;
        }

        tb.innerHTML = datetimeRangeHtml(dtStart, dtEnd, tokens);
      }
    } else if (direction === "up") {
      if (dtStart > 0) {
        const beforeHeight = wrap ? wrap.scrollHeight : 0;

        dtStart = Math.max(0, dtStart - DT_BATCH);

        // Enforce maximum window size by shifting dtEnd backward if needed.
        if (dtEnd - dtStart > MAX_WINDOW) {
          dtEnd = dtStart + MAX_WINDOW;
        }

/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak1.js */
        tb.innerHTML = datetimeRangeHtml(dtStart, dtEnd, tokens);

        if (wrap) {
          wrap.scrollTop += wrap.scrollHeight - beforeHeight;
        }
      } else {
         //refreshDateTimeHead();
        return;
      }
    }

    $("status").textContent =  
      `  Showing items ${dtStart} to ${dtEnd} of ${datetimeItems.length} (Sliding window active)`;

  } finally {
    isSliding = false;
    console.log("--> enforceSlidingWindow finished: isSliding =", isSliding);
  }
}

function buildGlobalChronologicalIndex() {
  // A rebuilt global index can reflect changed records or visibility settings, so
  // invalidate per-chat indexes at the same boundary. Otherwise they stay cached.
  currentChatNavIndexCache.clear();
  globalChronologicalIndexGeneration++;
  const entries = [];
  let seq = 0;

/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
  const seen = new Set();
  sourceMaps.forEach(function (map) {
    map.forEach(function (list, convKey) {
      (list || []).forEach(function (c) {
        const askNid = askNidPrefix(c) + "-" + (c.recordKey || c.localIndex);
        if (showAskNode(c) && !seen.has(askNid)) {
          seen.add(askNid);
          entries.push({ nid: askNid, ts: Number(c.ts) || 0, seq: seq++ });
        }
        (c.answers || []).forEach(function (a) {
          const ansNid = answerNidPrefix(a) + "-" + (a.recordKey || a.localIndex);
          if (showAnsNode(a) && !seen.has(ansNid)) {

            entries.push({ nid: ansNid, ts: Number(a.ts) || 0, seq: seq++ });

  // deterministic tie-breaker for equal or missing timestamps.

  globalIndexByNid = new Map();
  globalNidByIndex = new Map();
  entries.forEach(function (entry, i) {
    const index = i + 1;
    globalIndexByNid.set(entry.nid, index);
    globalNidByIndex.set(index, entry.nid);
  });
  updateGlobalNavSlider(globalIndexByNid.get(String(selectedNid || "")) || 1);
  updateExistingTimeNavSlider();
}

function updateGlobalNavSlider(index) {

  if (!slider || !count) return;

function drawExistingTimeHitStrip(items) {
  const canvas = $("existingTimeHitStrip");

  const total = items.length;
  const tokens = parseSearch($("q") ? $("q").value : "").tokens;
  const hasKeywordSearch = tokens.length > 0;
  const height = 4;

  // One backing-store pixel column per existing NID. CSS scales this bitmap
  // to the available width; item colors are assigned discretely, not blended.
  canvas.width = Math.max(1, total);
  canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return;
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  if (!total) return;

  for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
    const color = !hasKeywordSearch
      ? "#9aa0a6"                         // no active keyword search
      : searchHitNids.has(items[i].nid)
        ? "#269b68"                       // item has a keyword hit
        : "#d7a33d";                      // existing item, but no keyword hit
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(i, 0, 1, height);
  }
}

  return groups;
}

function jumpHit(i) {
  if (!hitList.length) return;

  hitCursor = (i + hitList.length) % hitList.length;
  const h = hitList[hitCursor];

  //selectedId = h.urlid;
  
  console.log( "in jumpHit , h.urlid is :", h.urlid   );
  console.log( "in jumpHit , h.nid is :", h.nid   );
  
  
  selectedId = h.nid;
  updateSelectionStatus("hit", h.nid, h.convKey);
  revealChat(h.convKey);

  if (String(h.node).indexOf("ans#") === 0 || String(h.node).indexOf("seo#") === 0) {
    openAns.add(h.convKey);
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
  }

  if (middleMode === "item") {
    // Preserve the existing DateTime-pane behavior.
    renderSlice(true);
    //alert (' hit ');
  } else {
    // Find the target session in the complete search result list.
    const targetIndex = matched.findIndex(
      r => String(r.id) === String(h.urlid)
    );

    if (targetIndex >= 0) {
      const tb = $("titleView");
      const pageStart = Math.floor(targetIndex / PAGE) * PAGE;
      const pageItems = matched.slice(pageStart, pageStart + PAGE);

      // Render the target page BEFORE looking for the target node.
      //tb.innerHTML = pageItems.map(rowHtml).join("");
      shown = pageStart + pageItems.length;
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */

      $("empty").hidden = matched.length > 0;
      $("status").textContent =
        shown + " of " + matched.length + " shown";

      updateHeaderIndicators();
    }
  }

  paintHits(parseSearch($("q").value).tokens);

  document.querySelectorAll("#hitBody tr").forEach(tr => {
    tr.classList.toggle(
      "on",
      Number(tr.dataset.hi) === hitCursor
    );
  });

  // Wait until the new title-pane DOM has been laid out.
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
    const activeBody = middleMode === "item"
      ? $("dateTimeView")
      : $("titleView");

    const row = $("titleView").querySelector(
      'tr[data-id="' + CSS.escape(String(h.urlid)) + '"]'
    );

    if (row) {
      row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
    }

    const node = activeBody.querySelector(
      '.ptt-node[data-nid="' + CSS.escape(String(h.nid)) + '"]'
    );

    if (node) {
      node.classList.add("ptt-jump");
      node.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });

/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
      setTimeout(() => {
        node.classList.remove("ptt-jump");
      }, 1200);
    }
  });
}

async function loadRecycle() {
  recycleItems = [];
  recycleAsks.clear();
  recycleChats = [];
  try {
    const res = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "get-recycle" });
    recycleItems = (res && res.rows) || [];
  } catch (_) {}
  const chats = new Map();
  recycleItems.forEach(function (item) {
    const convKey = item.convKey || ("recycle|" + item.id);
    if (!chats.has(convKey)) {
      const d = new Date(item.deletedAt || item.ts || Date.now());
      chats.set(convKey, {
        id: item.id,
        convKey: convKey,
        platform: item.platform || "",
        title: item.title || (rows.find(function (r) { return r.convKey === convKey; }) || {}).title || "(recycled)",
        conversationId: item.conversationId || "",
        url: item.url || "",
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
        date: fmtTs(d.getTime()).slice(0, 10),
        time: fmtTs(d.getTime()).slice(11),
        deletedAt: item.deletedAt || 0,
        askCount: 0
      });
    }
    const list = recycleAsks.get(convKey) || [];
    const kind = item.kind || (String(item.originKey || "").includes("|onMsg|") ? "onMsg" : "ask");
    if (kind === "answer") {
      const parentIndex = item.askLocalIndex || 0;
      let parent = list.find(function (a) { return a.localIndex === parentIndex && a.kind !== "answer"; });
      if (!parent) {
        parent = {
          recordKey: "recycle-dummy:" + item.id,
          text: "(ask not logged)",
          ts: item.ts || 0,
          source: "seen-dummy",
          kind: "ask",
          localIndex: parentIndex || "?",
          answers: []
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
        };
        list.push(parent);
      }
      parent.answers.push({
        recordKey: "recycle:" + item.id,
        text: item.text || "",
        ts: item.ts || 0,
        localIndex: item.localIndex || item.id,
        source: "seen"
      });
    } else {
      list.push({
        recordKey: "recycle:" + item.id,
        text: item.text || "",
        ts: item.ts || 0,
        deletedAt: item.deletedAt || 0,
        responseId: item.responseId || "",
        source: kind === "onMsg" ? "onMsg" : "seen",
        kind: kind,
        localIndex: item.localIndex || item.id,
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
        answers: []
      });
    }
    recycleAsks.set(convKey, list);
    chats.get(convKey).askCount = list.length;
    chats.get(convKey).deletedAt = Math.max(chats.get(convKey).deletedAt || 0, item.deletedAt || 0);
  });
  recycleChats = Array.from(chats.values());
}

function placeMenu(menu, dots) {
  menu.hidden = false;

  const w = menu.offsetWidth || 88;

  let left = r.right - w;

  menu.style.top = top + "px";

function appendUnrevealedForBag(limit) {
  const titleBody = document.getElementById("titleView");
  if (!titleBody) return;

  const source = (typeof filter !== "undefined" && filter === "recycle") ? recycleChats : rows;
  const bagMatched = source.filter(function (r) { return matchRow(r, ""); });

  const present = new Set();
  titleBody.querySelectorAll("tr[data-id][data-ck]").forEach(function (row) {
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
    present.add(String(row.dataset.ck || ""));
  });

  let missing = bagMatched.filter(function (r) { return !present.has(String(r.convKey)); });
  if (typeof limit === "number" && limit > 0) {
    missing = missing.slice(0, limit);   // ← only the next N
  }

  if (!missing.length) {
    document.getElementById("status").textContent = "No more unrevealed chat bars.";
    return;
  }

  titleBody.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", missing.map(rowHtml).join(""));
  document.getElementById("status").textContent = "Appended " + missing.length + " chat bars.";
}


function fillHolesInChatBars(limit) {
  const titleBody = document.getElementById("titleView");
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
  if (!titleBody) return;

  const source = (typeof filter !== "undefined" && filter === "recycle") ? recycleChats : rows;
  // bag only, ignore search
  const bagMatched = source.filter(function (r) { return matchRow(r, ""); });

  const present = new Set();
  titleBody.querySelectorAll("tr[data-id][data-ck]").forEach(function (row) {
    present.add(String(row.dataset.ck || ""));
  });

  let missing = bagMatched.filter(function (r) { return !present.has(String(r.convKey)); });
  if (typeof limit === "number" && limit > 0) missing = missing.slice(0, limit);
  if (!missing.length) {
    document.getElementById("status").textContent = "No holes to fill.";
    return;
  }

  // Insert each missing bar at the correct place according to bagMatched order
  missing.forEach(function (r) {
/* p2m: explorer-d\explorer1-bak2.js */
    const ck = String(r.convKey);
    const idx = bagMatched.findIndex(function (x) { return String(x.convKey) === ck; });
    // find the first already-rendered bar that should come AFTER this one
    let insertBefore = null;
    for (let i = idx + 1; i < bagMatched.length; i++) {
      const laterCk = String(bagMatched[i].convKey);
      const laterRow = titleBody.querySelector('tr[data-id][data-ck="' + CSS.escape(laterCk) + '"]');
      if (laterRow) { insertBefore = laterRow; break; }
    }
    const html = rowHtml(r);
    if (insertBefore) {
      insertBefore.insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", html);
    } else {
      titleBody.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", html);
    }
  });

}

const nidToConvKey = new Map(); // Maps every node ID directly to its exact convKey

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

// Keep the user-adjustable head-alignment offset across explorer reloads.
(function initHeadOffsetControl() {
  const key = "aiChatExplorerHeadOffsetPx";
  const input = $("headOffsetPx");
  if (!input) return;
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (saved !== null && /^[-+]?\d+$/.test(saved)) input.value = saved;
  } catch (_) {}
  input.addEventListener("change", function () {
    const value = Number.parseInt(input.value, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return;
    input.value = String(value);
    try { localStorage.setItem(key, String(value)); } catch (_) {}
/* p2m: explorer-y\explorer - z 5 add gocurr chat button every 100 items.js */
  });
})();

function buildGlobalChronologicalIndex() {
  // A rebuilt global index can reflect changed records or visibility settings, so
  // invalidate per-chat indexes at the same boundary. Otherwise they stay cached.
  currentChatNavIndexCache.clear();
  globalChronologicalIndexGeneration++;
  const entries = [];
  let seq = 0;
  const sourceMaps = [asksByConv, recycleAsks];
  const seen = new Set();
  sourceMaps.forEach(function (map) {
/* p2m: explorer-y\explorer - z 5 add gocurr chat button every 100 items.js */
    map.forEach(function (list, convKey) {
      (list || []).forEach(function (c) {
        const askNid = askNidPrefix(c) + "-" + (c.recordKey || c.localIndex);
        if (showAskNode(c) && !seen.has(askNid)) {
          seen.add(askNid);
          entries.push({ nid: askNid, ts: Number(c.ts) || 0, seq: seq++ });
        }
        (c.answers || []).forEach(function (a) {
          const ansNid = answerNidPrefix(a) + "-" + (a.recordKey || a.localIndex);
          if (showAnsNode(a) && !seen.has(ansNid)) {
            seen.add(ansNid);
            entries.push({ nid: ansNid, ts: Number(a.ts) || 0, seq: seq++ });
          }
        });
      });
    });
  });
  // Global numbering is oldest = 1, newest = N. Sequence is a stable
  // deterministic tie-breaker for equal or missing timestamps.
  entries.sort(function (a, b) { return a.ts - b.ts || a.seq - b.seq || a.nid.localeCompare(b.nid); });
/* p2m: explorer-y\explorer - z 5 add gocurr chat button every 100 items.js */
  globalIndexByNid = new Map();
  globalNidByIndex = new Map();
  entries.forEach(function (entry, i) {
    const index = i + 1;
    globalIndexByNid.set(entry.nid, index);
    globalNidByIndex.set(index, entry.nid);
  });
  updateGlobalNavSlider(globalIndexByNid.get(String(selectedNid || "")) || 1);
  updateExistingTimeNavSlider();
}
function globalIndexLabel(nid) {
  const index = globalIndexByNid.get(String(nid || ""));
  return index == null ? "" : '<span class="global-item-index" title="Global chronological index">#' + index + '</span>';
}

function updateGlobalNavSlider(index) {
  const slider = $("globalNavSlider");
  const count = $("globalNavSliderCount");
  if (!slider || !count) return;
  const total = globalNidByIndex.size;
/* p2m: explorer-y\explorer - z 5 add gocurr chat button every 100 items.js */
  slider.min = total ? "1" : "0";
  slider.max = String(Math.max(1, total));
  slider.disabled = total === 0;
  const current = total ? Math.max(1, Math.min(total, Number(index) || 1)) : 0;
  slider.value = String(current || 0);
  count.textContent = total ? current + " / " + total : "0 / 0";
}
